subject: Living-room storage around real routines
hook: Can you build alcove units around a radiator?
fb:
"We'd love alcove units, but there's a radiator and two sockets in the way." We hear this a lot, and it rarely stops a project.

Every socket, switch and radiator gets noted when we measure. Sockets can be left reachable inside a cupboard or through a neat cut-out. Radiators we never box in, because the heat has to get out — instead we design around them with an open section or a shelf above.

Worth knowing before the heating goes back on this autumn. Got an awkward wall? Ask us here:
https://superiofurniture.com/contact/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=plan-ahead-for-autumn&utm_content=day-357
gbp:
Can you build living-room storage around a radiator or sockets?

Yes. During the measure we record the position of every socket, switch and radiator on the wall, so the design works around them rather than discovering them on fitting day.

Sockets can stay accessible inside a cupboard, which is handy for chargers and media kit, or through a neat cut-out in a back or side panel. Radiators should not be fully boxed in, as that traps the heat, so we plan an open section, a shelf above, or leave the radiator clear with storage either side. The valve stays easy to reach.

Our free, no-obligation design consultation is the place to talk through an awkward wall. Get in touch to arrange one.
